name: agent-council
title_zh: 开会时把七个AI叫到一张桌上各说各的
tagline_zh: 拿不准的事别再自己纠结。一声令下，多个AI各自亮出观点，你坐在中间听它们吵，专治选择困难。
tagline_en: Stuck on a hard call? Summon multiple AIs, hear each one argue its side, and decide with the crowd's wisdom.
desc_en: Collect and synthesize opinions from multiple AI agents. Use when users say "summon the council", "ask other AIs", or want multiple AI perspectives on a question.
why_zh: 不是把答案拼起来，而是让不同模型独立表态再汇总，逼你看见单一AI的盲区，像真开了场圆桌会。
why_en: It doesn't merge answers—it stages a real debate. Independent takes surface blind spots no single model shows you.
limit_zh: 只负责召集和汇总观点，不负责投票裁决、不生成共识报告。每个AI的回答长短取决于它自己，你得自己读完全部内容。
limit_en: Only convenes and collects opinions—no voting, no consensus summary. You must read every response yourself.
title_en: Summon a council of AIs to debate your question
